scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @kodo/protocol && npm run build -w @kodo/platform && npm run build -w @kodo/host
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @kodo/protocol && npm run build -w @kodo/platform && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @kodo/protocol && npm run build -w @kodo/platform && npm run test -w @kodo/host
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start:desktop
scripts.dev:web: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-host.mjs && npm run dev -w @kodo/web
scripts.format: prettier --write packages apps scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check packages apps scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build && npm run stage:desktop && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:desktop:dir: npm run build && npm run stage:desktop && electron-builder --dir --config electron-builder.yml
